assessment.summary: Likely usable for CAD import and visual setup, but not likely to arrive as a clean articulated quadruped.

notes: Single PRODUCT entry suggests flattened or weak assembly hierarchy.
Many ADVANCED_FACE entities suggest dense CAD geometry.
No quick-hit assembly usage entities were found in a simple scan.

importPlan.firstStep: Import STEP into Isaac Sim CAD Converter and save as USD.
importPlan.secondStep: Inspect imported prim tree before attempting joints or drives.
importPlan.thirdStep: Use Robot Wizard only after identifying candidate link groupings.
